replace: Destination evidence (account-ownership verification or charity-signed bank letter) SHALL exist before the first electronic payment and after any bank-detail change.

Destination evidence SHALL exist before the first electronic payment and after any bank-detail change, and SHALL be either (a) a bank-originated account-owner match, or (b) a charity document AND an independent callback to a contact sourced from the charity registry or a prior verified record, never from the change request; a charity-signed letter alone SHALL NOT suffice. Every destination change SHALL notify the charity's previously verified channels, and the existing cooling-off period (UNB-RCN-WF-028) and independent callback (UNB-RCN-GRT-017) SHALL continue to apply. A bank-originated NOC matched on original trace, change code and COR trace SHALL count as destination evidence without cooling-off, notify the charity's verified channels and be logged under change control without a separate human approval; any charity-requested change triggered by an NOC follows the full rule.
acceptance_add: Given a bank-detail change supported only by a charity-signed letter, when release is requested, then it is held pending callback to a registry-sourced contact.
Given an NOC C01 matched to the original entry, when applied, then no cooling-off applies and the charity's verified contacts are notified.

replace: SHALL NOT be able to execute or indefinitely prevent a payment unilaterally

SHALL NOT be able to execute a payment, and SHALL NOT prevent one except through a protective hold executed under CNV-PLT-007 (a sponsor-adopted, time-bounded hold policy that the sponsor can always override through its own bank channel)
CNV-LEG-001.append: No AI feature or agent SHALL generate fund- or donor-specific securities or allocation recommendations, and AI explanations of sponsor-approved options SHALL be generated only from approved option metadata.

CNV-ARC-001.append: Recovery objectives SHALL be one versioned table keyed by data class and isolation profile: authoritative financial data SHALL have RPO 0 within region through synchronous standby; cross-region recovery SHALL declare a nonzero RPO under approved recovery semantics; consistency SHALL be per sponsor cell plus the hold-registry version recorded at each dispatch. Critical command paths (reservation, release, dispatch, hold publication) SHALL have reserved connection pools and worker capacity; batch, reporting, rendering and AI work SHALL read from replicas or snapshots under statement timeouts in separately scaled worker roles of the same build, and the benchmark SHALL run statement generation concurrently with peak dispatch.
acceptance_add: Given a statement run for the largest declared sponsor at peak dispatch load, when benchmarked, then dispatch latency stays within its declared SLO.

CNV-ARC-003.append: Because each sponsor has its own database, global hold publications SHALL be replicated into each sponsor database as inter-cell contract messages with a strictly increasing version; dispatch SHALL compare, in the same local transaction, the cell's applied version with a signed registry version beacon no older than an approved freshness bound, and SHALL fail closed for new dispatches when the bound is exceeded; a registry outage SHALL therefore stop only dispatches whose freshness bound has expired, never other tenants' reads or recommendations.
acceptance_add: Given the hold registry unavailable for longer than the freshness bound, when a sponsor cell attempts dispatch, then dispatch is refused and all non-dispatch functions continue.

CNV-GOV-004.append: While SPD-ADV-001 stands, reserved-authority holders, independent reconsideration reviewers and pre-contracted December surge reviewers SHALL each be exclusive to one sponsor; whether to replace the absolute rule with a recorded conflict rule (cross-appointments disclosed in each board resolution, no relationship to the matter, never deciding the same matter for two sponsors) is owner decision OD-M-01 (report 10).

replace: A SOC 1 type 2 covering a full period SHALL be planned once any user auditor plans to rely on Unbound controls or two or more user entities exist.

A SOC 1 type 2 covering a full period SHALL be planned when any user auditor states an intent to rely on Unbound controls; planning one earlier for cost spreading across two or more user entities is a business-policy default owned by the Unbound CFO.
Before live reliance by a sponsor, the sponsor's external auditor's written planned approach

Before live reliance by a sponsor, either the sponsor's external auditor's written planned approach, or a recorded 'planned approach pending' with the sponsor CFO's written acceptance of the interim evidence pack,

CNV-FIN-004.append: A new source SHALL start in ProvisionalCalibration: zero tolerance (exact match only), every non-exact item to the human queue and 100% review for at least one full close cycle of parallel run, after which the controller approves tolerances from the observed data. A break SHALL be attributed to funds through its unmatched items; an unattributable break SHALL open a controller decision, due within a sponsor-set number of business days, choosing between publishing affected statements marked 'provisional — reconciliation pending' and withholding them with notice, and statutory or contractual delivery deadlines SHALL prevail.
replace: Given a tolerance configuration with no calibration evidence, when activation is requested, then activation is refused.
Given a tolerance configuration with no calibration evidence, when activation is requested, then the source activates in ProvisionalCalibration with exact matching only.
ApprovalCommunicatedToGrantee (platform default; notice sent atomically with approval)
ApprovalCommunicatedToGrantee (platform default)
CNV-FIN-007.append: 'Communicated' SHALL mean a notice made available to the grantee through a durable channel (portal posting or recorded delivery to the grantee's verified address) at a recorded timestamp; recognition SHALL use that timestamp, and approved-but-undelivered notices SHALL appear on the cutoff register.
acceptance_add: Given an approval at 23:59 on 31 December whose notice is delivered at 00:02 on 1 January, when December closes, then the grant is listed as approved-not-communicated.

replace: Release 1 grant payments SHALL use networked rail partners acting as the sponsor's agent, with sponsor-originated ACH as fallback.

The grant rail SHALL be selected per program in the role table, with one PaymentInstruction contract shared by all rails and, for each rail, a named party that verifies destinations and handles returns. The release-1 default (networked partner rail or sponsor-originated verified ACH) is owner decision OD-M-03; until decided, a program SHALL declare its rail explicitly.
Verified ACH SHALL be the default rail, with checks and authorized hand delivery supported;
Electronic payment to a verified destination SHALL be the default (rail per CNV-PAY-001), with checks and authorized hand delivery supported;

CNV-PAY-007.append: When the feed is stale, releases of grants already reserved MAY proceed on an AlternativeBalanceAttestation (bank portal balance captured and attested by two treasury staff, valid for one business day) capped at the attested collected balance less outstanding instructions; new reservations SHALL wait for a fresh feed.

replace: Cumulative delegation-of-authority limits SHALL aggregate by entity, beneficiary or counterparty and related transactions across approvers within a 30-day window (candidate) and detect splitting.

Cumulative delegation-of-authority limits SHALL aggregate transactions that share a fund, a related-party group (donor household or 35% entities), the requesting principal, or a sponsor-operating payable counterparty, across approvers within a 30-day window (candidate), and detect splitting; recipient-level aggregation across unrelated funds SHALL be a detective analytic, not an approval gate.
acceptance_add: Given two $9,000 grants from unrelated funds to the same charity within 30 days, when approved, then no cumulative escalation occurs and the analytic records the pattern.

CNV-FIN-003.append: Per-donor exposure SHALL be the sum over return classes of amount times a treasurer-approved risk weight that decays with age (full weight inside the unauthorized-return window, small weight in the warranty tail).
acceptance_add: Given a donor whose only un-matured gifts are 70 to 700 days old, when a new contribution arrives, then the exposure cap is not triggered by them.

CNV-ENT-001.append: Installments already approved and reserved SHALL proceed; future occurrences of a recurring series whose only authorizing advisor has died SHALL be suspended from the date of credible notice until a successor confirms, unless program terms say otherwise.

CNV-PLT-005.append: A deterministic classification rule set with examples SHALL separate complaints from inquiries, automatic acknowledgment is allowed, and complaint incidence SHALL be measured in the CNV-EVB-001 time study before staffing.
acceptance_add: Given 200 contacts double-coded by two agents, when classification is validated before activation, then agreement reaches the sponsor-set rate.

Given the December readiness gate, when a simulation of P90 forecast December arrivals against rostered capacity including double absence shows any legal deadline missed or internal attainment below the sponsor floor, then the gate fails and the plan must be revised.

replace: Reusable application-layer components SHALL be owned by Forma, with temporary Unbound adapters tracked by a migration issue and no duplicated design system.

Forma SHALL be the preferred owner of reusable application-layer components; an Unbound adapter MAY remain indefinitely where the upstream service level is not met, with no duplicated design system, each adopted Echelon component pinned by release-manifest digest and covered by Unbound contract tests.
acceptance_add: Given a surface proposed for activation, when reviewed, then an Accessibility Conformance Report from automated tests plus manual assistive-technology testing exists.
Given an issued statement, when published, then an accessible HTML rendition from the same snapshot exists and any PDF passes PDF/UA-1 validation (veraPDF).

CNV-AIO-001.append: Release 1's agent-executable command set SHALL contain only reversible internal actions at authority A2 or below, enumerated in the authority matrix (CNV-GOV-010). Assistance metadata SHALL be generated from typed schemas and validation rules wherever possible; regulatory-implication text SHALL have an owner, version and effective date, be sampled for review each release, and be loaded only from the signed build.

replace: reasonable with cost-based evidence
reasonable, meaning a recovery ratio at or below the review trigger supported by a cost study

CNV-FIN-012.append: The binding full-accounting scope (AP, AR, purchasing, payroll interface, fixed assets) in FULL-ACCOUNTING-SYSTEM.md SHALL be read as 'available on demand, not release 1'; this narrowing is owner decision OD-M-02 pending ratification (report 10).

replace: prompt exception review
exception review within a sponsor-set number of business days
SHALL NOT make lawful transfer effectively impossible
SHALL NOT exceed the fully allocated cost of the transfer
